facts.fact: Olivia 的父母直到周四才发布声明，距她死亡已四天。
facts.anchor: It took Olivia’s parents until the Thursday to release a statement. Four days after her death.

facts.fact: Smith 与 Kate 在笔记本电脑上并肩读完声明，他说“非常动人”，Kate 反问他别这么愤世嫉俗。
facts.anchor: ‘Very moving,’ said Smith as they read it side by side on Kate’s laptop screen.

facts.fact: 当晚记者团在 Vicar Lane 一家繁忙的泰餐馆吃饭，同行抱怨警方不配合、认定“人已经抓到了”。
facts.anchor: They had dinner with the rest of the pack that night at a busy Thai restaurant on Vicar Lane.

facts.fact: 次日清晨 Smith 告知 Elliot 已被无条件释放、调查仍在继续，Kate 立刻要联系他做具名报道。
facts.anchor: ‘Nothing, it’s … Elliot’s been released without charge. Inquiries remain ongoing.

facts.fact: Kate 推断 Olivia 既找过 Aiden，也可能联系过 Emily 的其他旧识，比如只给过几句平淡引语的 Alice。
facts.anchor: If Olivia contacted Aiden Berkeley, then isn’t there a chance she also contacted other people who knew Emily Pierce?

facts.fact: Kate 用 Ancestry 查到 Aiden 的妻子叫 Gloria Jessop，并交叉核实她曾在 Leeds 教历史。
facts.anchor: First, to establish that Aiden had been married to a woman called Gloria Jessop

facts.fact: 她快出门时有人重重砸门，她一度想起 Twitter 威胁而僵住，随后听见 Smith 的声音。
facts.anchor: She was almost ready to leave when someone banged loudly on the door. The sound froze her to the spot.

facts.fact: Smith 改口：Kate 去守 Olivia 家门，他去 Bramhope 找前妻，并以身体堵住门口逼她交出地址。
facts.anchor: ‘Change of plan,’ he said, curtly. ‘I’m sick of standing on the doorstep. You cover it today and I’ll go and try the ex-wife.’
